goldens.publisher: UK Department for Energy Security and Net Zero (DESNZ)
goldens.dataset: Subnational total final energy consumption statistics: 2005 to 2024
goldens.table: workbook sheet '2024', row 7 (Code K02000001, "United Kingdom (inc unallocated)", "All local authorities"), cell H7, column "All fuels: Total"
goldens.measuresNote: Total FINAL energy consumption, all fuels and sectors, as estimated in the subnational series. Accredited Official Statistics. Workbook Note 1: transport covers road and rail only, and transport electricity is not included. The same sheet shows the DUKES UK total (row 8, 114622.15 ktoe) "for comparison purposes only" (Note 5); this golden is the subnational total, not the DUKES total.
